title: Large gift to Priya for her house down payment, I5 scenario

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: We got the house, Mom. Closing is in three weeks.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Then let me give you nine thousand toward the down payment. Your father would have wanted that.

conversation.speaker: priya
conversation.text: Mom, that is a lot. The bank will hold it, and I cannot approve it for you since it is coming to me.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Then I will answer their questions myself. It is my money and my daughter.

review_note: Real gift to daughter. Over 3x baseline so H-03 holds. Priya is beneficiary and must be refused as CO_APPROVER (I5). Completes via CUSTOMER_CHECKIN then BANK_REVIEW.
